text: In Simplicial TT, the ∞-categorical limits are defined as:
choices: Limits of simplicial diagrams in Top
Terminal objects in the appropriate slice category / right Kan extensions
explanation: Limits in ∞-cats: L = lim D is characterised by Hom(X,L) ≃ Nat(Δ_X, D) (right Kan extension along the constant diagram).
